name: Toblach (Italy)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, red and white, charged in its lower part with the municipal arms of Toblach (a red ring on white).
history: Municipal flag of Toblach, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Toblach arms — red ring on white
